en.title: 1978 Disability Rights Protest Sparks Ongoing Accessibility Advances Across Nations
en.summary: The 1978 protest demanding accessible public transit ignited the modern disability rights movement in the United States. Today, accessibility efforts continue with new assistive devices like the MouthPad tongue-controlled touchpad and Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses for blind veterans. Meanwhile, infrastructure projects in Wyoming and community initiatives in Rapid City highlight ongoing progress in physical and social inclusion.

zh-TW.title: 1978 年無障礙交通抗議點營殘障權利運動，全球無障礙進展持續
zh-TW.summary: 1978 年的無障礙公共交通抗議激發了美國現代殘障權利運動。近期，視障退伍軍人獲得 Ray-Ban Meta AI 眼鏡，並有討論將語音導航整合至《勇者鬥惡龍 X》遊戲。同時，懷俄明州的基礎建設改善與快速城市的殘障資源博覽會顯示持續的無障礙進展。
